text:
zoe.marketing: Heads-up 18hr till the announce. Need final yes on: stable docs permalink, changelog snippet, webinar demo time, and rollout windows. Can we lock by EOD PT?

mike.eng: pinged infra about pinned redirect. I can wire a 301 from /docs/feature-optimizer to the staging slug after tara confirms the final slug.

tara.docs: staging slug is /staging/feature-optimizer-v2 right now. I'll collapse it to /docs/feature-optimizer by 06:30 PT and include the short TL;DR for the blog. Changelog draft is here: https://internal/changelogs/feature-optimizer-v2.md (please don't share externally yet).

zoe.marketing: thanks. Marketing will need an excerpt (2 short bullets) and an OG image URL. I'll draft copy in #marketing-drafts and paste final excerpt here.

mike.eng: for rollout, I'd prefer a phased ramp: 5% at t+15m, 25% at t+90m, 100% at t+8h. Also adding a temporary rate cap for first 30m after each ramp to absorb webinar spikes.

oliver.product: webinar ask: let's do 9:00am PT workshop/demo. NA morning + late EU works. Will require 20m live demo + 10m Q&A. Can engineering have a short standby checklist?

mike.eng: standby checklist: monitor p95 latency, watch batch queue depth, hot-restart hook ready. I'll post the commands here before launch.

tara.docs: adding Known Limitations note: "token alignment may regress on very long prefix inputs; recommend switching to short-prefix mode" and a quick workaround. Also adding a code snippet for the blog: 
```
# python example
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
print(client.optimize("summary", model="rwd-opt-2"))
```

ci-bot: CI: changelog-publish job succeeded. artifact=build-589. deploy window opens 2024-10-17T06:00:00Z.

zoe.marketing: ok timeline recap -> everyone confirm:
- 06:00Z: changelog publish job (ci-bot)
- 06:30 PT: docs permalink /docs/feature-optimizer live (tara + mike)
- 09:00 PT: webinar/demo start (oliver)
- rollout: 5% @ t+15m, 25% @ t+90m, 100% @ t+8h (mike) with 30m post-ramp rate caps

mike.eng: confirmed. I'll also add a short rollback play (abort + revert routing) to the docs runbook.

tara.docs: permalink will be stable. I'll push OG metadata (title + description) and a small examples gallery.

oliver.product: will prepare 5 anticipated Qs and answers for support. Adding a short recommendation: route webinar leads to the "Early Adopter" inbound flow.

zoe.marketing: perfect. final action items:
- marketing: final post + OG image (zoe)
- docs: publish permalink + TL;DR + runbook link (tara)
- eng: rollout policy + rate caps + rollback script (mike)
- product: webinar Qs + inbound routing plan (oliver)

zoe.marketing: Ill post the final announcement copy here by 5:45pm PT. If anything changes on the infra side, call it out in this thread. :sparkles: :loud_sound:
